summary: Iteration 4 — Transaksi tab UI changes verified via mobile-viewport Playwright. All requested behaviors work: (1) camera 'Scan Barcode' button removed from Transaksi (only 1 stray 'Scan Barcode' text found on page and it lives on the Cek Harga tab, which is intentional); (2) top order is scan-mode-input (red border + green dot) → item-manual-button → cari-barang-button, confirmed by y-coordinates 23 < 64 < 116; (3) scan-mode-input is auto-focused and accepts submitted barcodes via Enter — known barcode 8992745550396 added '1 mitubaby tisu basah' Rp 6.000 to Daftar Belanja; unknown barcode shows toast 'Barcode ... belum terdaftar'; (4) cart-remove no longer deletes immediately — opens confirm sheet titled 'Hapus barang ini?' with delete-confirm and delete-cancel; Batal keeps the line, Hapus removes it; (5) edit-price sheet shows all three options (price-temporary, price-permanent, price-cancel); (6) Bayar button present. Backend GET /api/products/pos returns 2268 items. No regressions observed on the Transaksi tab.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx: unused styles `startBtn` and `startTxt` remain from the old empty-state 'Mulai' button (lines 308-309). Safe to remove but non-blocking.

Two console warnings observed (harmless on web preview): 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' and 'useNativeDriver not supported' from Animated. These originate from libraries and do not affect functionality.
